item.title: Apache-Sitgreaves National Forests Seek Public Assistance in Horse-Killing Investigation
item.description: The Apache-Sitgreaves National Forests are seeking information from the public about the recent killing of nine horses on the Black Mesa Ranger District. item.title: Mexican wolf population count complete
